Y. Ḥag. II, 77 a bot. הט' מוצע לכם the banqueting couch is spread for you (your reward in the hereafter is prepared).—2) dining room, reception room. Y. R. Hash. IV, 59 b bot. אפ' מט' לקיטון even if they adjourned from the tricl. to the sleeping room. Y. Keth. IV, 28 d; Y. Snh. XI, end, 30 c [read:] בעיא הדא אומנתא ט' וקיטין חופה וקיטון וכ' the following construction is required (in order to make the reception of the bride in the triclinium a legal consummation of marriage) a tricl. and a marriage chamber, and that chamber communicating with the tricl.—Ab. IV, 16, v. פְּרוֹזְדּוֹר.—Tosef. Sabb. XVI (XVII), 18 ט' שהסיקה … בה in a banqueting room (triclinium hibernum) which has been heated a day before …, you may entertain company on the Sabbath. Tosef. Bets. II, 10 ט' שהסיקוהו וכ'; a. e.—3) (τρίκλινος = ὅρριον, S.) granary. Y. Sot. V, 20 b bot. איטלק עלוי חד ט' וכ' he was fined to fill a granary of forty by forty &c.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (נטר, cmp. אִטְּרִי) preservar, conservar, esp. peixe salgado ou em conserva.
definicoes_originais: (נטר, cmp. אִטְּרִי) preserve, pickle, esp. salted or pickled fish.
notas_originais: Meg. 6 a טמוני זו ט' ‘stored things’ (Deut. XXXIII, 19) refers to tarith (as a valuable article of commerce); Sifré Deut. 354; Num. R. s. 13.—Ab. Zar. II, 6 ט' טרופה brine containing hashed tarith (when you cannot recognize the clean and unclean fish). Ib. ט' שאינה טרופה in which the fish can be recognized. Ned. VI, 4 he who vows abstinence from ‘fish’ מותר בט' טרופה is permitted to partake of hashed t. Ber. 44 a

notas_originais: ch.
Ib. תמן … לט' וכ' (not ליט') there they call taritha tsa ḥ ăna

verbetes.glosa_atual: (um comp. de טֶרֶךְ a. סִיד) cimento de ligação.
definicoes_originais: (a comp. of טֶרֶךְ a. סִיד) binding cement.
notas_originais: Tosef. Sot. XV, 9 if one put sand in the lime, הרי זה ט' ואסור ed. (ed. Zuck. טרכיו סיד הוא, Var. טַרְכֵי סיד) it is cement and therefore forbidden; B. Bath. 60 b הרי זה ט' (Ms. O. טַרְכְּסָאוֹ the binding of it (the lime), cmp. טְרַקְסִין); Sabb. 80 b (Ms. M. תר'). [Treat. S’maḥ. VIII טרכסי', in a corrupt passage, prob. to be read: כרכים.]
, v. טְרוֹקְסִ'

verbetes.glosa_atual: (ampliação de טרך ou טרק, v. טָרֵיךְ, a. טְרַק I) [ um agitador de vinho,] uma tábua na qual são misturadas as bebidas para a mesa, aparador (ábaco, mensa delphica), uma tábua lisa presa à parede com dobradiças, para ser colocada para cima e para baixo (cmp. דְּלִפְקִי, Kel. XXV, 1).
definicoes_originais: (enlargement of טרך or טרק, v. טָרֵיךְ, a. טְרַק I) [ a wine-stirrer,] a board on which drinks for the table are mixed, side-board (abacus, mensa delphica), a plain board attached to the wall with hinges, to be put up and down (cmp. דְּלִפְקִי, Kel. XXV, 1).
notas_originais: Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. III, 3 ט' חלק (R. S. to Kel. XXV, 1 טרכוס וחלק) a plain tray (without rims). Ib. I, 12 ט' שעשה וכ' a side-board under which they placed a piece of wood, formed like a spear (as an improvised support) for eating at it. Tosef. Sabb. XIV (XV), 2 תרקוש ed. Zuck. (Var. ט', by cler. error מרקוש).
Y. Taan. IV, 68 d top מעברתא דט' the ford of T.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. próximo w.) [um tarsiano,]; tecelão de fio metálico, tecelão artístico, diferem. frag. גַּרְדִּי.; trabalhador em cobre, bronze etc. Casco.
definicoes_originais: weaver of metallic thread, artistic weaver, differ. fr. גַּרְדִּי.
notas_originais: — Pl. טַרְסִיִּים. Ab. Zar. 17 b Ar. a. Ms. Pes. (ed. תרס', v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 40). Succ. 51 b וט' בפ"ע וכ' (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 400) artistic weavers apart and common weavers apart; Tosef. ib. IV, 6.—Sabb. 47 a מטה של ט' the weavers’ horizontal loom or frame for embroidery (differ. in Rashi).
57 b מטלית של ט' the bronzers’ apron.

gent. of Tarsus, Tarsian.— Pl. טַרְסִיִּים, טוּרְ'. Meg. 7 a בגתן … שני ט' היו והיו מספרים בלשון טרסי Ms. M. (only בגתן … שני טרשיים היו) Bigthan and Teresh were two Tarsians and conversed in the Tarsian language; ib. 13 b שני ט' … טורסי (Ms. M. … תרסיים תרסי). Ib. 26 a בה"כ של ט' Ms. M. (ed. טור'; Tosef. ib. III (II), 6 אלכסנדרים) the synagogue of the Tarsians in Jerusalem (Rashi: of the bronze-workers, v. preced.). Y. Shek. II, 47 a בה"כ של ט' (Yeb. 96 b טבריא).
, read: סְרַטְיָאוֹת.

Y. Gitt. VII, beg. 48 c; Y. Ter. I, 40 b (perh. proper noun).— Pl. טַרְסַיָּא, טַרְסַיָּיה. Y. Kil. IX, end, 32 d.—Lev. R. s. 35, end כנישתא דט' וכ' the synagogue of the weavers in Lydda (or bronze-workers, or Tarsians), v. טַרְסִי II.
Targ. Y. I Gen. X, 4 טַרְסַס ed. Amst. (oth. eds. טרסיס, v. אַלַּס); Targ. I Chr. I, 7 טרסוס ed. Lag.—2) (prob.) Tartessus, in Spain. Targ. Ps. XLVIII, 8. Ib. LXXII, 10. [V. טריסיס.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (τρισκελής, τρισκέλλων, sub. כסא) uma cadeira com três pernas, esp. uma cadeira de acampamento.

notas_originais: Num. R. s. 12; Tanḥ. Naso 19; (Tanḥ. T’rumah 9; Gen. R. s. 68 תְּרוֹנוֹס). Sabb. 138 a כסא ט' (Ms. O. כסא וט').

notas_originais: Sabb. 53 a bot.; (Tosef. ib. IV (V) 5 קרסטלין, Var. קרטלין). B. Mets. 90 a (Ms. M. קרסטילין, oth. Mss. קרסטלין, קסרטל, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).

verbetes.glosa_atual: [ mover-se com veemência,]; rasgar, presa.; lançar com força, bater, golpear; jogar fora, rejeitar, ejetar.; apreender à força.
definicoes_originais: to cast with force, knock, strike against; to throw away, reject, eject.
to chop, hash, to beat, mix.
to make טְרֵפָה, to inflict an organic defect.
to be in disorder, a) (with דעה, or לב) to be confused, bewildered, not fully conscious.
to reject one’s petition, to refuse.
to disfigure, to make ungainly by spots, incisions &c., v. טָרוּף).
to cast about (a ship on high sea), v. Hithpa.—Part.
to become t’refah, to be afflicted with a fatal organic disease.
(denom. of טֶרֶף) a) to cover with foliage.
notas_originais: Lev. R. s. 26 טוֹרֵף ואוכל tears in order to satisfy his appetite. Koh. R. to X, 11 הארי ט' the lion goes out for prey. Sot. 47 b טוֹרְפֵי טֶרֶף those robbing (the poor). Zeb. 53 b חלקו של טוֹרֵף the territory of the tearer (wolf = Benjamin, Gen. XLIX, 27). B. Kam. 116 b לטוֹרְפָהּ to plunder it; a. fr.

Ḥull. III, 3 טְרָפָהּ בכותל he cast or knocked the bird against the wall. Pesik. R. s. 11; Num. R. s. 2 מגרשה אני טוֹרְפָהּ אני I will divorce her, I will cast her out (cmp. טָרַד).—Ber. 5 b טוֹרְפִין לו וכ' his prayer is thrown in his face (refused). Y. Yeb. XVI, 15 d top טְרָפַנִי, v. טָרַד.
Yoma IV, 1 ט' בקלפי he took the ballot out with haste.—Esp. to seize for a debt. B. Mets. 15 a ובא ב"ח וטְרָפָהּ and a creditor of the previous owner came and seized it, v. טִירְפָּא.

Sabb. XIX, 2 ט' יין ושמן beat wine and oil; a. e.—Part. pass. טָרוּף, f. טְרוּפָה. Ib. 38 a בשר ט' chopped meat. Ab. Zar. II, 6, v. טָרִית. Y. Nidd. IV, 51 a (of a foetus). Sabb. VIII, 5 (80 b) ביצה ט' an egg beaten and mixed with oil; a. fr. V. טָרוּף.
Kil. IX, 1. Y. Orl. III, 63 a; Y. Keth. VI, end, 31 a צמר בכור שטְרָפוֹ wool of a first-born that has been hackled (and mixed up with, other wool).
Makhsh. II, 4 הטוֹרֵף את גגו (Var. המטהר) if one scrubs his roof; Tosef. ib. I, 8.
Ḥull. 85 b, sq. צא טְרוֹף go and maim the animal (before slaughtering it).
Ib. 9 a, a. e. במה נִטְרְפָה from what cause it became t’refah

Y. Sabb. II, 5 b bot. נִטְרְפָה דעתו של אבא my father’s mind is unclear; Snh. 68 a. Ib. 43 a כדי שתִּטָּרֵף דעתו (not שתטרוף) that his (the culprit’s) consciousness may be benumbed; Num. R. s. 10.—Ib. נ' לבו his mind becomes confused (from drinking); a. fr.—b) (with שעה, of political disturbances) to be troubled. Snh. 11 a; Sot. 48 b; Tosef. ib. XIII, 5 נטרפה (ה)שעה the political condition was too much troubled (persecutions prevailing). Y. Dem. V, 24 d bot.; a. e.
Succ. III, 9 כל העם מטָרְפִין בלולביהן ed. Y. (Mish. ed. Pes. מט'את לול'; ed. מנעועין) all the people shook their branches constantly (during the recitation at Hallel, contrad. to נענע).
—Part. pass. מְטוֹרָף. Num. R. s. 10 לבו מ' וכ' his mind is disturbed and he talks improper things, v. supra.
Part. pass. מְטוֹרָף. Ber. V, 5 שהוא מ' that he (the patient for whom prayer is said) is rejected (bound to die), opp. מקובל accepted.
Part. pass. as ab. Koh. R. to X, 11 the serpent is asked מפני מה גופך מט' why has thy body been disfigured (v. Gen. III, 1
pass. as ab.; pl. מְטוֹרָפִים, מְטוֹרָפִין. Yeb. 47 a, v. סָחַף.
Num. R. s. 12, end; Cant. R. to VI, 4; Pesik. Vayhi p. 10 a, a. e. לא הִטְרִיפוּ the animals were found to be free from an organic disease.—[
Yalk. Gen. 119, v. רָטַב.—b) to sprout with moisture, be sappy. Gen. R. s. 69 ה' מצות וכ' (Yalk. Jud. 38 הפריח) sprouted with good deeds &c., v. רָטַב.—[

נִיטָּרֵף to be tossed about, to be in a storm near the shore. Taan. III, 7 (19 a) על הספינה המִיטָּרֶפֶת וכ' for a ship which is seen from the coast to be tossed about; ib. 14 a המְטוֹרֶפֶת (v. supra; Ar. ed. Koh. נִטְרֶפֶת Nif.). Tosef. Sabb. XIII (XIV), 11 נִיטָּרְפָה ספינה וכ' the ship has been thrown back several times (was prevented from landing by the breakers).

verbetes.glosa_atual: ,; tomar à força, apreender.; lançar, golpear, derrubar.; bater, agitar, bater.
definicoes_originais: to be knocked about, dashed; to be tossed about; to be in spasms.
to be spotted, full, of incisions &c., v. supra a. טָרוּף.
notas_originais: B. Mets. 14 a אתי … וטַרְפָהּ מיניה (not וטרפא) the creditor came and took it from him (by legal seizure); ib. וקא טָרֵיף ליה מיניה (Ms. H. וטַרְפָהּ מיניה).—ט' לקוחות to seize property sold by the debtor, v. לְקוּחוֹת. Ib. 19 a; a. fr.
Y. Snh. X, 29 a וטָרֵיף לון לארעא and let them fall down. Lam. R. to I, 5 ויִטְרוֹף גרמיה and let him throw himself down. Ib. to IV, 2 טְרוֹף קולתיך וכ' cast down thy pitcher before me; a. fr.

Ber. 28 a ט' אבבא knocked at the door. Snh. 97 a.—Ib. 67 b ט' ליה בטבלא he struck the tabla before him; a. v. fr.—Trnsf. to carp at, to contest the validity of a decision. Y. Snh. I, beg. 18 a בעי מִיטְרוֹף wanted to protest (against R. Isaac’s decision because he acted as a single judge).—5) to declare t’refah. Ḥull. 10 b. Ib. 48 b סבר … למִיטְרְפָהּ Mar … wanted to declare it t’refah; a. fr.— Part. pass. טָרִיף a) struck down (in the agony of death). Targ. Jud. III, 25; IV, 22 (h. text נֹפֵל). Lam. R. to IV, 5 טְרִיפִין בקיקלא (not טריפון) lying on dunghills.—b) thrown away. Y. Snh. X, 29 a top הא טריפין לך they are thrown down before thee (cmp. טְרוּן).—c) (denom. of טרפא, v. טָרוּף) spotted, full of incisions; planed. Ned. 25 a; Shebu. 29 b, v. טָרוּף.—[Y. Shebi. I, end, 33 c א"ר יודן כד טריפן לעוביה, read with R. S. to Shebi. I, 8: א"ר יודן בר טרפון or טריפון, לעוביה being a corrupt tautography of ליעז' ב"י = ליעזר בן יעקב.]
Targ. II Kings VIII, 12 (h. text רטש). Targ. Nah. II, 8 (h. text תפף).

verbetes.glosa_atual: mesmo, esp. אַמָּה ט' as duas divisórias cobertas de cedro, com um espaço vago entre elas, que separavam o Santo dos Santos do Santo e ocupavam o espaço de um côvado, o texto (I Reis VI, 16) deixando indeciso de qual das duas áreas sagradas aquele espaço de côvado foi deduzido.
definicoes_originais: same, esp. אַמָּה ט' the two cedar-covered partitions, with a vacant space between, which separated the Holy of Holies from the Holy and occupied the space of one cubit, the text (I Kings VI, 16) leaving it undecided from which of the two sacred areas that cubit’s space was deducted.
notas_originais: In the second Temple that partition was replaced by two curtains with a space between. Midd. IV, 7 אמה ט' one cubit for the partition. Yoma 51 b אבל … אמה ט' וכ' but in the second Temple, where there was no partition wall, … they made two curtains. B. Bath. 3 a; a. fr.—Y. Kil. VIII, 31 c bot. (among doubtful things) ואמה ט' (add to the above six things) the ammah traksĭn. מהו ואמה 'ט why is it called a. tr.? (Answ., taking our w. for τάραξιν, acc. of τάραξις, confusion) טריכסון מהו מבפנים מבחוץ (ἐτάραξεν, cmp. בריכסון) it created confusion: what is it? inside? outside?; Y. Yoma V, 42 b bot. טירקסון.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (טְרַשׁ II) [ surdez,] (sub. רִבִּית) usura surda ou silenciosa, tarsha, uma venda no prazo a um preço mais alto do que o vendedor aceitaria se vendesse por dinheiro, por exemplo. vende-se cerveja em Tishri (quando é barata), para ser paga em Nisan (quando a cerveja é mais alta) ao preço de Nisan.
definicoes_originais: (טְרַשׁ II) [ deafness,] (sub. רִבִּית) deaf or silent usury, tarsha, a sale on time at a price higher than the seller would take if he sold for cash, e.g. one sells beer in Tishri (when it is cheap), to be paid for in Nisan (when beer is higher) at the Nisan price.
notas_originais: B. Mets. 65 a ט' שרי tarsha is permitted (is no usury). Ib. ט' דידי my (R. Papa’s) tarsha (sale of date beer on time &c., v. supra). Ib. ט' דידי ודאי וכ' my (R. Ḥama’s) tarsha (selling goods to be carried at his risk to the dearer market, the money to be paid on returning) &c. Y. ib. V, 10 c bot. אין זו רביתא אלא ט' (not הטרשא) this is not direct usury, but it is tarsha.— Pl. טַרְשֵׁי. Bab. ib. 68 a ט' פפונאי, expl. כט' דרב פפא like the sales of R. Papa, v. supra.
